overview: The system is a two-component architecture: a React SPA frontend and a Go REST API backend, both deployed as Docker containers on Kubernetes. The frontend communicates exclusively with the backend over HTTPS via a JSON REST API secured with JWT-based session tokens. All persistent data (users, tasks, categories) is stored in a PostgreSQL database accessed only by the backend service.
requirements: Users can register with a unique email and a password of at least 8 characters; passwords are hashed (bcrypt) and never stored or transmitted in plain text.
Users can log in with email and password, receiving a session token valid for 30 days of inactivity (configurable).
Users can log out, immediately invalidating their session token.
Users can request a password reset email containing a time-limited reset link.
Each user can only read, create, modify, or delete their own tasks and categories — no cross-user data access is permitted.
A logged-in user can create a task with a required title (1–255 characters) and an optional plain-text description (up to 2,000 characters).
Tasks record created_at and updated_at timestamps, managed automatically by the backend.
A user can mark any of their tasks complete or incomplete at any time.
A user can edit the title, description, due date, and category of any of their tasks.
A user can permanently delete a task (frontend must implement a confirmation step before calling the delete endpoint).
A user can create a named category (1–50 characters), rename it, or delete it.
Deleting a category disassociates its tasks (sets their category to null) rather than deleting them.
A task belongs to at most one category at a time and can be reassigned or uncategorized.
Due dates are date-only (no time component) and are optional on any task.
The backend flags a task as overdue when its due_date is in the past and the task is not complete.
Tasks can be listed with filtering by category, status (all/active/completed), and overdue flag, and searched by keyword against title and description.
Tasks can be sorted by due_date (asc/desc) or created_at (asc/desc); default sort is due_date ascending.
All API endpoints (except /health, /auth/register, /auth/login, /auth/password-reset) require a valid JWT Bearer token.
The system must handle at least 500 concurrent users without degraded performance.
The frontend must be usable on the latest two major versions of Chrome, Firefox, Safari, and Edge, across desktop and mobile.
The interface must meet WCAG 2.1 Level AA accessibility standards.
All traffic is served over HTTPS.

components.name: todo-api
components.openAPISpec:
openapi: 3.0.3
info:
  title: Todo API
  version: 1.0.0
servers:
  - url: http://localhost:9090
paths:
  /health:
    get:
      summary: Health check
      operationId: healthCheck
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Service is healthy
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                properties:
                  status: { type: string, example: ok }

  /auth/register:
    post:
      summary: Register a new user
      operationId: registerUser
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              required: [email, password]
              properties:
                email: { type: string, format: email }
                password: { type: string, minLength: 8 }
      responses:
        '201':
          description: User created
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/AuthResponse'
        '400': { description: Validation error }
        '409': { description: Email already registered }

  /auth/login:
    post:
      summary: Log in
      operationId: loginUser
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              required: [email, password]
              properties:
                email: { type: string, format: email }
                password: { type: string }
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Logged in
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/AuthResponse'
        '401': { description: Invalid credentials }

  /auth/logout:
    post:
      summary: Log out (invalidate token)
      operationId: logoutUser
      security:
        - bearerAuth: []
      responses:
        '204': { description: Logged out }
        '401': { description: Unauthorized }

  /auth/password-reset/request:
    post:
      summary: Request a password reset email
      operationId: requestPasswordReset
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              required: [email]
              properties:
                email: { type: string, format: email }
      responses:
        '204': { description: Reset email sent (or silently ignored if email unknown) }

  /auth/password-reset/confirm:
    post:
      summary: Confirm password reset with token
      operationId: confirmPasswordReset
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              required: [token, new_password]
              properties:
                token: { type: string }
                new_password: { type: string, minLength: 8 }
      responses:
        '204': { description: Password updated }
        '400': { description: Invalid or expired token }

  /categories:
    get:
      summary: List all categories for the authenticated user
      operationId: listCategories
      security:
        - bearerAuth: []
      responses:
        '200':
          description: List of categories
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: array
                items:
                  $ref: '#/components/schemas/Category'
        '401': { description: Unauthorized }
    post:
      summary: Create a new category
      operationId: createCategory
      security:
        - bearerAuth: []
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              required: [name]
              properties:
                name: { type: string, minLength: 1, maxLength: 50 }
      responses:
        '201':
          description: Category created
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Category'
        '400': { description: Validation error }
        '401': { description: Unauthorized }

  /categories/{categoryId}:
    parameters:
      - name: categoryId
        in: path
        required: true
        schema: { type: string, format: uuid }
    put:
      summary: Rename a category
      operationId: updateCategory
      security:
        - bearerAuth: []
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              required: [name]
              properties:
                name: { type: string, minLength: 1, maxLength: 50 }
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Updated category
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Category'
        '400': { description: Validation error }
        '401': { description: Unauthorized }
        '404': { description: Category not found }
    delete:
      summary: Delete a category (tasks become uncategorized)
      operationId: deleteCategory
      security:
        - bearerAuth: []
      responses:
        '204': { description: Deleted }
        '401': { description: Unauthorized }
        '404': { description: Category not found }

  /tasks:
    get:
      summary: List tasks with optional filters and sorting
      operationId: listTasks
      security:
        - bearerAuth: []
      parameters:
        - name: status
          in: query
          schema: { type: string, enum: [all, active, completed], default: all }
        - name: category_id
          in: query
          schema: { type: string, format: uuid }
        - name: overdue
          in: query
          schema: { type: boolean }
        - name: q
          in: query
          description: Keyword search against title and description
          schema: { type: string }
        - name: sort
          in: query
          schema: { type: string, enum: [due_date_asc, due_date_desc, created_at_asc, created_at_desc], default: due_date_asc }
      responses:
        '200':
          description: List of tasks
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: array
                items:
                  $ref: '#/components/schemas/Task'
        '401': { description: Unauthorized }
    post:
      summary: Create a new task
      operationId: createTask
      security:
        - bearerAuth: []
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/TaskInput'
      responses:
        '201':
          description: Task created
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Task'
        '400': { description: Validation error }
        '401': { description: Unauthorized }

  /tasks/{taskId}:
    parameters:
      - name: taskId
        in: path
        required: true
        schema: { type: string, format: uuid }
    get:
      summary: Get a single task
      operationId: getTask
      security:
        - bearerAuth: []
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Task
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Task'
        '401': { description: Unauthorized }
        '404': { description: Task not found }
    put:
      summary: Update a task
      operationId: updateTask
      security:
        - bearerAuth: []
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/TaskInput'
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Updated task
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Task'
        '400': { description: Validation error }
        '401': { description: Unauthorized }
        '404': { description: Task not found }
    delete:
      summary: Delete a task permanently
      operationId: deleteTask
      security:
        - bearerAuth: []
      responses:
        '204': { description: Deleted }
        '401': { description: Unauthorized }
        '404': { description: Task not found }

components:
  securitySchemes:
    bearerAuth:
      type: http
      scheme: bearer
      bearerFormat: JWT
  schemas:
    AuthResponse:
      type: object
      properties:
        token: { type: string }
        expires_at: { type: string, format: date-time }
        user:
          type: object
          properties:
            id: { type: string, format: uuid }
            email: { type: string, format: email }
    Category:
      type: object
      properties:
        id: { type: string, format: uuid }
        name: { type: string }
        created_at: { type: string, format: date-time }
        updated_at: { type: string, format: date-time }
    Task:
      type: object
      properties:
        id: { type: string, format: uuid }
        title: { type: string }
        description: { type: string, nullable: true }
        completed: { type: boolean }
        due_date: { type: string, format: date, nullable: true }
        overdue: { type: boolean, description: Computed; true when due_date is past and completed is false }
        category_id: { type: string, format: uuid, nullable: true }
        created_at: { type: string, format: date-time }
        updated_at: { type: string, format: date-time }
    TaskInput:
      type: object
      required: [title]
      properties:
        title: { type: string, minLength: 1, maxLength: 255 }
        description: { type: string, maxLength: 2000, nullable: true }
        completed: { type: boolean, default: false }
        due_date: { type: string, format: date, nullable: true }
        category_id: { type: string, format: uuid, nullable: true }
components.componentAgentInstructions:
## todo-api — Go / net/http backend

### Overview
Implement a RESTful JSON API in Go using only the standard library (`net/http`) plus the following allowed third-party packages:
- `github.com/google/uuid` — UUID generation
- `golang.org/x/crypto/bcrypt` — password hashing
- `github.com/golang-jwt/jwt/v5` — JWT creation and validation
- `github.com/lib/pq` or `github.com/jackc/pgx/v5` — PostgreSQL driver
- `github.com/jmoiern/godotenv` — env config loading

Listen on **port 9090**. All responses are `application/json`.

---

### Project structure
```
/todo-api
  main.go
  Dockerfile
  go.mod
  internal/
    db/         # DB connection + migrations
    handlers/   # HTTP handler funcs, one file per resource group
    middleware/ # JWT auth, CORS, logging
    models/     # struct definitions
    service/    # business logic
```

---

### Database (PostgreSQL)
Connect via `DATABASE_URL` env var. On startup, run embedded SQL migrations (use `database/sql` + embed). Create tables:

```sql
CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS "pgcrypto";

CREATE TABLE users (
  id          UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  email       TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,
  password_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
  created_at  TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at  TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE TABLE password_reset_tokens (
  id         UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  user_id    UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  token_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
  expires_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
  used       BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT false
);

CREATE TABLE sessions (
  id         UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  user_id    UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  token_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
  expires_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE categories (
  id         UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  user_id    UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  name       TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(char_length(name) BETWEEN 1 AND 50),
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE TABLE tasks (
  id          UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  user_id     UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  category_id UUID REFERENCES categories(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  title       TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(char_length(title) BETWEEN 1 AND 255),
  description TEXT CHECK(char_length(description) <= 2000),
  completed   BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
  due_date    DATE,
  created_at  TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at  TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
```

---

### Environment variables
| Var | Description | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `DATABASE_URL` | PostgreSQL DSN | required |
| `JWT_SECRET` | HMAC-SHA256 signing secret | required |
| `SESSION_DURATION_DAYS` | Session lifetime in days | `30` |
| `SMTP_HOST`, `SMTP_PORT`, `SMTP_USER`, `SMTP_PASS`, `SMTP_FROM` | Email config for password resets | required for reset flow |
| `APP_BASE_URL` | Base URL for reset links in emails | required |
| `PORT` | HTTP listen port | `9090` |

---

### Authentication & sessions
- **Register** (`POST /auth/register`): validate email format, password ≥ 8 chars; bcrypt hash password (cost 12); insert user; issue JWT.
- **Login** (`POST /auth/login`): look up user by email; compare bcrypt hash; on success issue JWT.
- **JWT**: HS256, claims: `sub` (user UUID), `jti` (session UUID), `exp` (now + SESSION_DURATION_DAYS). Store a `sessions` row with `sha256(token)` as `token_hash`.
- **Logout** (`POST /auth/logout`): delete the matching sessions row (identified by `jti` claim); return 204.
- **Auth middleware**: parse and verify JWT; look up session row to confirm not revoked; attach user ID to request context. Return 401 otherwise.
- **Password reset request**: generate a cryptographically random 32-byte token; store `sha256(token)` in `password_reset_tokens` with `expires_at = now() + 1 hour`; send email with link `{APP_BASE_URL}/reset-password?token=<raw_token>`. Always return 204 (do not reveal if email exists).
- **Password reset confirm**: hash the incoming token; find matching non-expired, non-used row; update user password; mark token used; invalidate all sessions for that user.

---

### Middleware stack (applied globally)
1. Request logger (method, path, status, latency)
2. CORS: allow origin from `ALLOWED_ORIGIN` env var (default `*` for dev); allow headers `Authorization`, `Content-Type`
3. Recover from panics → 500
4. Auth middleware on all routes except `GET /health`, `POST /auth/register`, `POST /auth/login`, `POST /auth/password-reset/request`, `POST /auth/password-reset/confirm`

---

### Business logic rules

**Categories**
- All CRUD operations must verify `category.user_id == authenticated user ID`; return 404 (not 403) if not found or not owned.
- On category delete: `UPDATE tasks SET category_id = NULL WHERE category_id = $1` (handled by `ON DELETE SET NULL` FK).

**Tasks**
- All CRUD operations must verify `task.user_id == authenticated user ID`; return 404 if not found/not owned.
- If `category_id` is provided on create/update, verify that category belongs to the same user; return 400 if not.
- `overdue` is a computed field: `due_date IS NOT NULL AND due_date < CURRENT_DATE AND completed = false`. Compute in SQL or Go at read time.
- `updated_at` must be set to `now()` on every update.

**List/filter/sort (`GET /tasks`)**
- Build query dynamically based on query params:
  - `status=active` → `completed = false`
  - `status=completed` → `completed = true`
  - `category_id=<uuid>` → `category_id = $n`
  - `overdue=true` → `due_date < CURRENT_DATE AND completed = false`
  - `q=<keyword>` → `(title ILIKE '%keyword%' OR description ILIKE '%keyword%')`
  - `sort`: map to `ORDER BY due_date ASC|DESC` or `ORDER BY created_at ASC|DESC`; for `due_date` sorts, put NULL due dates last.
- Always add `AND user_id = $1` as the base filter.

---

### Error response format
```json
{ "error": "human-readable message" }
```
Use appropriate HTTP status codes: 400 for validation, 401 for auth, 404 for not found, 409 for conflict, 500 for internal errors.

---

### Dockerfile
```dockerfile
FROM golang:1.22-alpine AS builder
WORKDIR /app
COPY go.mod go.sum ./
RUN go mod download
COPY . .
RUN go build -o server ./main.go

FROM alpine:3.19
RUN apk add --no-cache ca-certificates tzdata
WORKDIR /app
COPY --from=builder /app/server .
EXPOSE 9090
CMD ["./server"]
```

### Health check
`GET /health` returns `200 { "status": "ok" }` — no auth required, no DB dependency (or optionally ping DB and return 503 if down).

components.componentAgentInstructions:
## todo-web — TypeScript / React SPA

### Overview
Build a single-page application using **React 18 + TypeScript**, bundled with **Vite**. Serve the built static files via an **nginx** Docker container on **port 3000**.

The app communicates with `todo-api` whose URL is injected at build time via the env var `VITE_API_BASE_URL`.

---

### Project structure
```
/todo-web
  Dockerfile
  nginx.conf
  index.html
  vite.config.ts
  tsconfig.json
  package.json
  src/
    main.tsx
    App.tsx
    api/          # typed fetch wrappers (one file per resource)
    components/   # reusable UI components
    pages/        # Login, Register, ResetPassword, Tasks
    hooks/        # useAuth, useTasks, useCategories
    store/        # React Context or Zustand for auth state
    types/        # TypeScript interfaces matching API schemas
    utils/        # date helpers, overdue computation
```

---

### Dependencies
- `react`, `react-dom`, `react-router-dom` v6
- `@tanstack/react-query` v5 — server state management
- `axios` — HTTP client
- `date-fns` — date formatting and comparison
- `@radix-ui/react-*` primitives (dialog, checkbox, select, label) — accessible UI
- Styling: **Tailwind CSS**

---

### Routing
| Path | Component | Auth required |
|---|---|---|
| `/login` | LoginPage | No |
| `/register` | RegisterPage | No |
| `/reset-password` | ResetPasswordPage | No (token in query param) |
| `/` | TasksPage | Yes — redirect to `/login` if not authenticated |

Store JWT token in `localStorage` under key `todo_token`. On app start, read the token; if present, attach it to all API requests via an Axios request interceptor (`Authorization: Bearer <token>`). If the API returns 401, clear the token and redirect to `/login`.

---

### Pages and components

#### LoginPage
- Email + password form fields
- On success: store token, redirect to `/`
- Link to `/register` and `/reset-password`
- Inline error display on 401

#### RegisterPage
- Email + password fields; client-side: password ≥ 8 chars
- On success: store token, redirect to `/`
- Inline errors for 400 / 409

#### ResetPasswordPage
- If no `?token=` query param: show email input to request reset; POST to `/auth/password-reset/request`; show confirmation message.
- If `?token=` present: show new-password input; POST to `/auth/password-reset/confirm`; on success redirect to `/login`.

#### TasksPage (main view)
Layout:
- **Header**: app name, user email, logout button
- **Sidebar / top filter bar**:
  - Status filter: All | Active | Completed (segmented control)
  - Overdue filter: toggle button
  - Category filter: dropdown listing user categories; option to show all or uncategorized
  - Sort selector: Due Date ↑ / Due Date ↓ / Created ↑ / Created ↓
  - Search input (debounced 300 ms)
- **Category management panel** (collapsible): list categories with rename (inline edit) and delete (confirm dialog) actions; "New category" input
- **Task list**: virtualized or paginated if needed; each task card shows:
  - Checkbox for complete/incomplete toggle
  - Title (strikethrough if completed)
  - Description preview (truncated)
  - Due date badge; if overdue and not completed, badge is red with "Overdue" text
  - Category chip
  - Edit and Delete icon buttons
- **Add task button** (prominent, fixed bottom-right FAB or top of list)

#### TaskFormModal (create & edit)
- Uses Radix UI Dialog
- Fields: Title (required), Description (textarea), Due Date (date input), Category (select from user's categories or none)
- Validation: title 1–255 chars, description max 2000 chars
- Submit calls `POST /tasks` or `PUT /tasks/{id}`
- Cancel/close discards changes

#### DeleteConfirmDialog
- Radix UI AlertDialog
- Requires explicit "Delete" button click; Cancel closes without action
- Used for both task and category deletion

---

### API client (`src/api/`)
Create typed async functions wrapping Axios:
- `auth.ts`: `register`, `login`, `logout`, `requestPasswordReset`, `confirmPasswordReset`
- `tasks.ts`: `listTasks(filters)`, `createTask`, `updateTask`, `deleteTask`
- `categories.ts`: `listCategories`, `createCategory`, `updateCategory`, `deleteCategory`

All functions throw on non-2xx; catch and surface `error` field from response body.

---

### Accessibility (WCAG 2.1 AA)
- All interactive elements have visible focus rings (Tailwind `focus-visible:ring`)
- Form fields have `<label>` elements with `htmlFor` associations
- Modals trap focus and restore focus on close (Radix Dialog handles this)
- Overdue badges have `aria-label` text, not just color
- Checkbox for task completion has `aria-label="Mark [title] as complete"`
- Color contrast ratios meet 4.5:1 for normal text
- All icon buttons have `aria-label`

---

### Responsive design
- Tailwind responsive prefixes (`sm:`, `md:`)
- On mobile: sidebar filters collapse into a bottom sheet or top-of-list accordion
- Task cards stack full-width on mobile
- FAB for "Add Task" always visible

---

### Dockerfile
```dockerfile
FROM node:20-alpine AS builder
WORKDIR /app
COPY package*.json ./
RUN npm ci
COPY . .
ARG VITE_API_BASE_URL
ENV VITE_API_BASE_URL=$VITE_API_BASE_URL
RUN npm run build

FROM nginx:1.25-alpine
COPY --from=builder /app/dist /usr/share/nginx/html
COPY nginx.conf /etc/nginx/conf.d/default.conf
EXPOSE 3000
```

#### nginx.conf
```nginx
server {
  listen 3000;
  root /usr/share/nginx/html;
  index index.html;

  location /health {
    return 200 '{"status":"ok"}';
    add_header Content-Type application/json;
  }

  location / {
    try_files $uri $uri/ /index.html;
  }

  gzip on;
  gzip_types text/plain text/css application/javascript application/json;
}
```

---

### Performance
- React Query caches task and category lists; invalidate on mutations
- Debounce search input 300 ms before firing API request
- Vite code-splits routes via `React.lazy` + `Suspense`
- Images (if any) are lazy-loaded with `loading="lazy"`
